tei:div.tei:p: kun mkhyen 'jam dpal bzang po'i lo rgyus/

༄༅/ /kun mkhyen 'jam dpal bzang po ni/ gdung rus rje nā ro pa'i dngos slob dus mkhyen gyi bla mar gyur pa chos rje rdzong pa'i dbon brgyud yin/ 'di pa tshang gi zhal ngo yin phyin chad/ ring bsrel ngo mtshar can 'byung bar grags shing brgyud pa lnga tsam la drung na rim gyi yongs 'dzin bzhes pa kho na byung ba'i gdung rigs su yab dbang rgya ba chos kyi rin chen gyi mched zla/ yum chos kyi sgrol ma gnyis kyi sras su 'dam gzhung du sku 'khrungs/ yi ge 'dri klog sogs tshegs med du mkhyen/ rje btsun sgrol ma zhal gzigs/ bla ma chos rin pa'i drung du rdo rje phreng ba sogs kyi dbang lung mang po zhus/ tshal min pa bsam gtan bzang po'i drung nas bsnyen par rdzogs/ mtshan 'jam dpal bzang por btags/ rong ston drung nas gzhung lugs du ma gsan/ lha bu ba'i drung nas gcod skor rnams zhus/ rje rol pa'i rdo rje dang drung 'jam dbyangs pa dang ti shri kun dga' blo gros kyi thugs sras sngags phyogs kyi phyag len la shin tu mkhas pa khu bo chos rin pa'i drung nas mtshur phur sngags chog gi lag len thams cad la byang bar mdzad/ gtso bor rje don ldan zhabs kyi drung nas go shri dang lhan cig chos drug lo bzhir zhus/ rtags mtshan nyams myong rnams bka' brgyud gong ma rnams bzhin byung bas chos rje rin po che thugs shin tu mnyes par gyur/ kong dgon du bka' 'gyur tshar gcig gzigs pas phyag rgya chen po rang grol du ngo 'phrod/ yi dam gyi lha du ma zhal gzigs/ phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam/ sku tshe yang mthar phyin/ mchog gi sprul pa'i sku yang thugs dam nyams khrid kho na la sbyor bar mdzad pa sogs bstan 'gro yongs la gcig tu sman pa'i bka' drin zla ma mchis shing spang rtogs mthar son pas don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa ste/ rje 'di nyid kyi phyi nang gi rnam thar la bstod pa ngag gi dbang pos mdzad pa 'di ltar/

swa ra swasti/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'jam dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa la bstod pa dge legs dpyid kyi snye ma zhes bya ba/ mgon po 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// gang sku mkha' mnyam sku mchog brnyes kyang zhing 'dir skal mnyam sgyu ma'i sku// gang gsung gzhom med mkha' mnyam brnyes kyang skal ldan legs bshad sgrog/ gang thugs gyur med bde chen brnyes kyang mkha' mnyam 'gro la brtse ba can// rnal 'byor dbang phyug sa gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma gang de'i zhabs la 'dud// rgyal ba rigs brgya'i sgyu 'phrul sku brnyan ni// thabs shes ti la ka yi 'du 'phrod las// zhing 'dir bltams dang sgyu rtsal rtsed 'jo'i 'gros// gzhon nu'i rol gar cir yang ston la 'dud// 'khor ba'i ngang tshul nag po brtsegs pa'i mtshor// 'dod sred zhags pa'i 'phrul gyis ma drangs par// ha la'i rgya mtsho bsreg za'i 'obs lta bur// nyer gzigs nges 'byung stobs mnga' de la 'dud// mkhan slob spyan sngar bstan rtsa tshul khrims kyi// rnam dag bslab pa'i dngos por bsnyen rdzogs nas// nyes ltung dri bral bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin// 'gro ba'i mchod rten mchog tu gyur la 'dud// mkhas mang nye dbang dbus na brgya byinabazhin// mngon par rab gsal yongs 'dzin mkhas mang la// zab cing rgya che'i mdo sngags gzhung lugs kun// nye bar nod de khong du chud la 'dud// de ltar mkhas pa'i go 'phang seng ge'i khrir// nye bar 'dzegs te mi 'jigs spobs pa yis// de nyid bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la// thogs med smra ba'i seng ger gyur la 'dud// khyad par rigs kyi cod pan sprul ba'i sku// in+d+ra snyil gyi gtsug tor cher gsal ba// 'khor zhi'i khyab bdag mthong thos don ldan la// mnyes pa gsum gyi mnyes mdzad de la 'dud// de yi zhal rgyun bdud rtsi lam gsum babs// rnam dpyod shel gyi bum par nod pa yis// ji lta ji snyed chos gzugs ngo mtshar ba//

rab snang mngon du gyur ba de zhabs 'dud// chos kyi rgyal po de yi chos kyi khrir// 'jigs med srid rtser lhang nge'i gsung dbyangs kyis// rgyal tshab rgyal ba'i sras su dbang bskur te// kun gyis bstod phyag yul gyur de la 'dud// sgra tshad bzo dang gso rig gzhung la sogs// ji snyed tha snyad shes bya'i gnas kun la// sgrib bral spyan zur yangs pa skyod tsam gyis// ngang tshul ji lta ji snyed mkhyen la 'dud// sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde chen po bzhi'i// dbang rgyud man ngag lung bshad mtha' dag la// 'jigs med spobs pas ma lus thugs chud nas// mkhyen spyan 'gran zla kun bral de la 'dud// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal bzod dka' ma bzod pa'i// snying rje'i spyan chab gaṅgā'i chu rgyun bzhin// rab 'babs byams dang snying rje byang chub sems// smon 'jug spyod rlabs mthar phyin de la 'dud// tha mal snang ba lha yi 'khor lor gzigs// rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin mngon du gyur// rdo rje slob dpon las rim rab 'byams la// dbang sgyur 'khor lo'i bdag pa de la 'dud// gtum mo'i me lce srid las rnam rgyal gyis// he ru ka dngos bde chen zla ba'i rgyun// gsang chen dga' bzhi'i zlos gar lhur mdzad pas// dpe don ye shes mngon du gyur la 'dud// rlung sems gnyis med 'od zer lnga pa'i lus// dag dang ma dag sgyu 'phrul cir yang ston// de nyid yan lag bdun ldan skur bzhengs pa'i// yang dag sgyu lus mngon gyur de la 'dud// mgrin pa'i 'khor lor e yig bskul byed pa'i// las rlung las snang bag chags grong bcom ste// lha sku rang shar spel sbyangs mthar phyin pa'i// nying 'khrul rang sangs rmi lam mkhan der 'dud// gdod ma'i mi shigs thig le 'od gsal ba// srab 'thug nyams rtogs 'od gsal rim pa yis// ma rig mun bsal chos sku mngon du mdzad// ji lta ji snyed mkhyen gzigs de la 'dud//

ma rig bag chags rnam smin grong spangs te// bde chen thar pa chen po'i grong khyer du// rlung sems gar mkhan thogs med nyer 'pho ba'i// gnyug ma'i rgyal srid skyong ba de la 'dud// 'chi srid spangs nas 'chi med chos sku brnyes// bar srid med par bde chen longs spyod rdzogs// skye srid bral yang sprul skus 'gro don mdzad// bar do'i g.yul rgyal dpa' po de la 'dud// rang la bzhugs pa'i rang gi de bzhin nyid// bla ma'i dus thabs bdag gi bsod nams las// rang ngo mngon gyur rang 'khrul ri mo yal// 'od gsal phyag chen rtogs pa de la 'dud// de ltar zab dang rgya che'i nyams bzhes kyis// chos kyi rgyal po'i go 'phang de brnyes nas// ris bral mdzad pa rgya mtshos thub pa'i bstan// rgyas mdzad bstan pa'i bdag po de la 'dud// khyad par rgyal dbang drug pa seng ge dang*// rgyal ba dkon mchog yan lag la sogs pa// rgyal ba kun gyi rigs kyi cod pan gyur// rgyal ba kun las ches cher rgyal par 'dud// lhag pa'i lha tshogs til gyi gang bu bzhin// mngon par rab gzigs dka' brgyud bstan pa'i gtso// dam can rgya mtsho bka' las mi 'da' zhing*// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro sprin bzhin 'du der 'dud// lhar bcas srid zhi'i khyon khengs tshangs dbyangs kyis// legs bshad zab dang rgya che spel ba'i rgyun// 'khor ba ji srid de tsam rgyun chad med// phrin las lhun grub mnga' ba de la 'dud// de ltar zhing 'di'i sgyu 'phrul bkod pa'i sprin// re shig bsdus te ḍā ki'i zhabs 'bring dang*// bcas te de bzhin nyid kyi rgya mtshor thim// slar yang 'gro don mkha' khyab mdzad der 'dud// sku gsung thugs ni rgyal ba'i rdo rje gsum// snod bcud rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor la// shes bya thams cad rang rig chos skur shar// rgyal ba mi gzugs chos kyi rgyal por 'dud// de ltar bstod pa'i mchod sprin 'di spros pas//

bdag cag srid lam 'khyams pa'i 'gro ba rnams// bka' brgyud bstan pa'i snying po phyag rgya che// nyams su blangs te srid las grol gyur cig/ dang por yengs med dran pa'i rgyun goms shing*// bar du rtsol med rig pa'i rang so tshugs// tha mar 'khrul pa'i dri ma kun zad de// sems nyid yid bzhin nor bu rtogs gyur cig/ dran dang shes bzhin mig gis reg tsam gyis// snang srid dbyings rig dbyer med ngang du zhu// gdod ma'i e waṃ a ham̐ ro mnyam pa// phyin ci ma log rgyud la 'char gyur cig/ bla ma'i rigs bdag sems dang dbyer med 'dres// smin grol dam tshig sdom pa dri ma med// yongs rdzogs thub bstan nyams len khur khyer pa'i// rgyal ba dgyes pa'i rgyal sras nyid gyur cig/ rang nyid srid las grol ba de tsam du// ma tshogs 'gro la mi bzod brtse ba'i rgyun// dbyar mtsho bzhin 'phel chos kyi rgyal po yi// go 'phang thob ste 'khor ba stong byed shog/ ces so//
